column1: # Durable records written WITHOUT asking scripts/lib/durable-record.sh, each with
# the reason nothing can stage its subject. ovation#368.
# scripts/check-durable-records.sh refuses an unrouted writer missing from here, a
# line with no reason, and a line for a file that no longer has one. Two tab
# separated columns: the script, relative to scripts/, and the reason.

column2: Its subject is a person: Dan runs it by hand to write down what a relaunched installed build showed him, and nothing in it runs a browser, a command or a build that could be injected. Its suite points OVATION_GRANT_RECORD at a throwaway file on every case.

Its append is the bracket log of ovation#570, written only when a caller names OVATION_LIVE_DATA_BRACKET_LOG, and the only callers are the runner's own suites, which name a file in their throwaway directory so they can prove each staged inner run measured a throwaway root. A real run names none and writes nothing, so staged runs are the whole of its subject rather than something to keep out of it.
